issues.problem: Declared state relations still require their own state captures

report.scope: Declared DOM ownership, rendered geometry, row grouping and sample width. These measurements do not certify visual equivalence or undeclared relationships.

fonts.scope: Actual Chromium platform fonts, declared role metrics and solid-background text contrast. Explicit caller stress overrides require matching real browser activation. Complex surfaces require separate rendered evidence; font-family declarations alone do not establish fidelity.
